papers.title: Bayesian Optimization-based EKF Covariance Auto-tuning and Robustness Evaluation for Sensorless PMSM Drives
papers.venue: Journal of Institute of Control Robotics and Systems

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究永磁同步电机无传感器驱动的EKF协方差贝叶斯优化整定，与FEA代理建模、生物力学或植入物设计无直接关联。
llm.why_not_core: This paper addresses motor drive control tuning via Bayesian optimization, with no FEA surrogate modeling, no biomechanics, and no implant-related application.

summary_zh.motivation: 无传感器永磁同步电机驱动中EKF协方差矩阵整定依赖经验，影响估计精度。
summary_zh.method: 采用贝叶斯优化自动搜索EKF协方差参数，并评估其鲁棒性。
summary_zh.result: 所提方法可自动获得较优协方差配置并提升转速估计鲁棒性。
summary_zh.validation: 基于电机驱动仿真案例进行验证。

summary_en.motivation: Covariance tuning for extended Kalman filters in sensorless permanent-magnet synchronous motor drives typically relies on manual heuristics that limit estimation accuracy.
summary_en.method: Bayesian optimization is employed to automatically tune the EKF covariance parameters, followed by a robustness evaluation of the tuned filter.
summary_en.result: The proposed auto-tuning scheme achieves improved covariance configurations and enhanced speed-estimation robustness compared with manual tuning.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed through simulation case studies of the motor drive system.
